name: Yattsu Kazoero
source:
"Your days are ruined."
The overdue return to one's hometown.
The death of a father.
It was an ordinary life.
Until...

Become a young man who experiences the end of normalcy as life takes an unusual turn.
A young girl. A battle. Death. Undying.
Supernatural weaponry. A secret organisation.
Become a protector, a mentor, a murderer... a king.
The bizarre two-day world.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE100737.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
"你的人生毁了。"迟来的回乡。父亲的去世。曾经平凡的生活。直到……成为一个经历正常生活终结、人生走向异常的年轻男人。一个少女。一场战斗。死亡。不死。超自然武器。一个秘密组织。成为守护者、导师、杀人犯……国王。奇异的两天世界。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE100737.html]DLsite English[/url]]
